Al fianco del nuovo CEO resterà Moreno Carullo, cofondatore e Chief Technology Officer. Capdevielle will become Executive Advisor after overseeing the cybersecurity company's growth to more than AUD $143 million in revenue and its AUD $1.4 billion acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric. Carcano served as Nozomi's original Chief Executive Officer when he and co-founder Moreno Carullo launched the business. The leadership change returns the operational technology, Internet of Things and cyber-physical systems security company to founder-led management. The move follows Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of Nozomi, which was presented as preserving the company's independent operations and vendor-neutral approach. His expertise spans product management, marketing, business development, and strategic execution, backed by an MBA from UC Berkeley's Haas School of Business.
